services.name: Sea Kayak
services.desc: Looking for a unique way to experience Halifax from the water? Look no further! Join us for an ocean paddle in the beautiful and historic Halifax Harbour (Kjipuktuk). Our experienced tour guides showcase some of the of the best views in Halifax - while ensuring a safe, entertaining and informative adventure. Tours can be customized to individual skill levels, but No previous kayaking experience needed! For each of our tours, we offer both single kayaks and double kayaks (holds two people in one kayak).
